Landing.title: Post smarter. From the first second.
Landing.subtitle: Posts, promotions, analytics and scheduling — all in a minute, with the posty.now AI assistant.
Landing.step1Body: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and more — in one place.
Landing.step2Body: Text, photo, or video. Just say what you need.
Landing.step3Body: Captions, hashtags, and the best time to publish.
Landing.step4Body: Publish instantly across every connected platform.

About.title: About us
About.p1: posty.now is an AI assistant for social media. You talk, it drafts, schedules, and publishes — without bouncing between apps.
About.p2: One studio for captions, promotions, analytics, and timing. Built to feel quiet and fast, not crowded.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.subtitle: A question, a partnership, or a hello — send it here. We’ll reply by email.
Contact.name: Name
Contact.success: Message received. We’ll get back to you soon.
Contact.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.body: We collect the account details you provide, the content you create in the studio, and messages you send through this site so we can operate posty.now. We do not sell your data. Contact us if you want a copy of what we store, or to ask that it be deleted.

Terms.title: Terms
Terms.body: By using posty.now you agree to use the product lawfully, keep your login private, and remain responsible for the content you publish to connected social accounts. The service is provided as-is while we grow. We may update these terms; the current version will always live on this page.

Auth.signupSubtitle: Email and password. No extra steps.
Auth.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm the account, then sign in.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.snapshot: A snapshot of connections and the queue.
Dashboard.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Connect Instagram, TikTok, and the rest from Accounts.
Dashboard.nothingScheduled: Nothing scheduled. Draft in chat and hit Schedule.

Accounts.title: Accounts
Accounts.intro: Connect through Zernio’s hosted OAuth. Facebook Pages, LinkedIn orgs, Pinterest boards, and Google locations use Zernio’s picker after login.
Accounts.connectedNamed: {platform} connected. You can publish from chat.
Accounts.connectedGeneric: Account connected. You can publish from chat.

Chat.title: Studio chat
Chat.subtitle: Draft captions, ask for ideas, or tell me to publish.
Chat.empty: Try “Give me three Instagram captions for a rainy Monday coffee shop” or connect an account and say “publish this to Instagram now”.
Chat.connectToPublish: Connect accounts to publish from chat.
Chat.placeholder: Ask for a caption, or write one and publish it.
Chat.posted: Posted. Check the dashboard for live links as they land.
